inputs.policy: the FROZEN v1 cell (alpha 0.45, tau 0.65, top-k 5, m 5 / c 2 / top_l 3, rrf 0.5/0.3/0.2) through rails.kb_policy's OWN pure functions
inputs.query_texts: the LANDED M0 arm's own per-sample direct-decode answers, each verified against that arm's direct_response_sha256 record
inputs.query_vectors: already-durable embeddings on this row; nothing is embedded here

limitation: Pass A re-flies the direct decode. The program's known multi-slot decode-variance channel means a minority of flown texts will not reproduce the M0 text byte for byte (attempt 1: 4 of 26; attempt 2: 5 of 58). Where the text diverges the dispatch decision may differ, so this is a PROJECTION over the same population under the same policy, not a prediction of the flown count. The registered attempt ceiling carries a margin on top of it.
